title: At the Doctor's / A cikin likita
bridge: A cikin yare Espanyol, domin mu nuna ciki da haske muna da 'me duele' + wata fuska (me duele la cabeza). A cikin turanci, tsarin yana da wata sabon tsari: 'I have' + 'a headache' (ina da haske). Wannan sabon tsari ne saboda ba a ce 'I hurt my head' ba don haske mai yawa. Kuma a turanci, 'hurt' yana aiki kamar jimla: 'My head hurts' (fuskina tana da haske). Karatu da yadda ake haifar da 'have' tare da manyan suna na haske da 'hurt' tare da manyan suna za su zama muhimmi don koyaushe ka sani yadda za ka yi magana da yin koyo da yin magana da yin magana da yin magana da yin magana.
rule: Don yin magana game da halaye da cututtuka a turanci a matakin A2, muna yin amfani da: 1) 'I have' + manyan suna (a headache, a cold, a fever, a cough, a sore throat, a stomachache, etc.) don nuna cewa kana da wata halin. 2) 'My [wata fuska]' + 'hurts' ko 'My [wata fuska] is sore' don nuna haske a wata wata fuska. 3) 'I feel' + sifa (sick, dizzy, tired, etc.) don nuna halaye mai yawa. A cikin tambayoyi da amsa mai yawa, muna yin amfani da 'do/does' (Do you have...? Yes, I do. No, I don't). Don ba da shawara, muna yin amfani da 'should' / 'shouldn't' (You should rest, You shouldn't eat spicy food). Yi tunanin cewa 'hurt' yana da wata matsakaiciyar jimla: hurt - hurt - hurt. Ba a yi amfani da 'me duele' daidai ba; a kan sau da yaushe a kan sabunta manyan suna: 'My head hurts' (ba 'I hurt my head' ba ko da yaushe a kan yi wata fasaha). Kuma muna da 'I've got' kamar wata tsari mai yawa na 'I have got' (I've got a cold). A cikin fasaha mai yawa, muna iya yin amfani da 'I have a cold'.

concept_examples.text: I have a headache and a sore throat.
concept_examples.translation: Ina da haske a fuskina da haske a baki.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə ˈhɛdeɪk ənd ə sɔːr θroʊt/

concept_examples.translation: Fuskina tana da haske bayan in ci abinci.

concept_examples.text: You should drink a lot of water.
concept_examples.translation: Ya kamata ku sha ruwa mai yawa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd drɪŋk ə lɒt əv ˈwɔːtər/

common_error.explanation: Yin kuskure yana daga daidaitawa da 'me duele la cabeza' kamar 'I hurt my head'. Amma 'hurt' kamar jimla ta yin wata fasaha (me lastimé la cabeza). Don nuna haske mai yawa, muna yin amfani da 'have a headache' ko 'my head hurts'. Yi tunanin cewa: 'hurt' kamar jimla ta yin wata fasaha (intransitive) yana nuna ciki da haske, amma tare da manyan suna (my head hurts). Yi kwararraka cewa ya kamata ku yi amfani da 'have' + manyan suna don halaye da cututtuka mai yawa.

examples.original: I have a cold.
examples.translation: Ina da cutar.
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'have' + cuta ko halayen. Kad'a 'I am cold' ba don cuta, wannan yana nuna cewa kana da haske.

examples.original: I have a cough and a runny nose.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə kɒf ænd ə ˈrʌni noʊz/
examples.translation: Ina da yunwa da ruwa a baki.
examples.note: El orden de los síntomas con 'and' es común: cough and runny nose. Fíjate en 'runny nose' (nariz que moquea).

examples.original: I feel dizzy.
examples.translation: Ina da rai.
examples.note: 'Feel' + adjetivo para estados físicos. En español usamos 'me siento', pero en inglés no se usa 'I feel me'.

examples.original: Take this medicine twice a day.
examples.translation: Kada ku dauwo wannan magani sau biyu a rana.
examples.note: Jimla 'take' yana da amfani da magani, ba 'drink' (sha). 'Twice a day' yana nuna sau biyu a rana.

examples.original: You should rest in bed.
examples.translation: Ya kamata ku zauna a gida.
examples.note: Para dar consejos, 'should' + verbo infinitivo. Es más suave que 'must' (obligación).

examples.original: I need to make an appointment.
examples.translation: Ina bukata zuwa wata appointment.
examples.note: Usa 'make an appointment' para pedir cita médica. 'Need to' + verbo indica necesidad.

examples.original: My back hurts a lot.
examples.translation: Fuskina tana da haske mai yawa.
examples.note: 'A lot' a karshen ko bayan jimla. Kad'a 'my back hurts much' ba tare da 'a' ba.

examples.original: I have a sharp pain in my chest.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə ʃɑːrp peɪn ɪn maɪ tʃɛst/
examples.translation: Ina da haske mai zurfi a filin zuciya.
examples.note: Usa 'sharp' para dolor agudo y 'dull' para dolor sordo. Describe la ubicación con 'in my + parte del cuerpo'.

examples.original: My knee is swollen and red.
examples.translation: Kwadiyarsa tana da haske da jini.
examples.note: Usa 'is' + adjetivo para describir estado. Recuerda que 'swollen' es un adjetivo irregular.

title: Booking Accommodation / Rashin da kaya
bridge: A cikin Turanci, muna yin amfani da 'would like' + 'to book' don yin adadin kalmomi mai zurfi kamar 'I would like to book a room', amma a cikin Turanci, 'reservar' da 'book' su ne makamancin 'reserve'. Wata kalmomi masu muhimmanci ne 'for' don nuna lokacin (for two nights), saboda a Turanci ba'a yi amfani da 'por' kamar a Turanci. Wani abun da ya fi zurfi shine cewa a Turanci, 'double room' ya fi 'habitación doble' saboda kalma 'double' ta kasance a gaba da 'room'.
rule: Don rashin da kaya a Turanci a matakin A2, yi amfani da fasaha kamar: 'I would like to book...' (Ina son rashin da kaya...), 'I'd like to make a reservation' (Ina son yin rashin da kaya). Za ka iya yin amfani da fasaha mai saukin yin bayani game da shi: 'My name is...'. Don kwanaki, yi amfani da 'on' tare da kwanaki ('on Monday') da 'for' tare da lokaci ('for three nights'). Don tambayar game da matsakaici, yi amfani da 'Do you have...?' ko 'Is there...?'. Yanzu, fasaha na yanzu na rashin da kaya: 'single room' (kaya mai sauki), 'double room' (kaya mai biyu), 'twin room' (kaya mai biyu da kaya). Da fatan za a koma da 'adjective + noun' a Turanci. Don bayyana fasaha, yi amfani da 'with' (da): 'with a view' (da fasaha), 'with breakfast' (da abincin fasaha).

concept_examples.text: I would like to book a double room for two nights.
concept_examples.translation: Ina son rashin da kaya mai biyu da kaya a lokacin biyu da dare.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tə bʊk ə ˈdʌbəl ruːm fɔː tuː naɪts/

concept_examples.text: Do you have any rooms available for this weekend?
concept_examples.translation: Do you have rooms available for this weekend?
concept_examples.phonetic: /duː juː hæv ˈɛni ruːmz əˈveɪləbəl fɔː ðɪs ˌwiːkˈɛnd/

concept_examples.text: I'd like a room with a sea view, please.
concept_examples.translation: Ina son kaya da fasaha ga cikin rami, da fatan zai zama.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk ə ruːm wɪð ə siː vjuː pliːz/

concept_examples.text: How much does it cost per night?
concept_examples.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ dʌz ɪt kɒst pɜː naɪt/

common_error.wrong: I want reserve a room for two nights.
common_error.correct: I would like to reserve a room for two nights.
common_error.correct_alt: I'd like to book a room for two nights.
common_error.explanation: A Turanci, muna yin amfani da 'would like' (Ina son) saboda 'want' ya fi zurfi. 'I want reserve' ba daidai ba ne saboda ba a cikin 'to' da 'reserve'. Yanzu, fasaha na 'book' (rashin da kaya) ya fi zurfi a cikin hoton.

examples.original: Do you have a single room available?
examples.phonetic: /duː juː hæv ə ˈsɪŋɡəl ruːm əˈveɪləbəl/
examples.translation: Do you have a single room available?
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'Do you have...?' don tambaya a fasaha mai yau. 'Available' ya kasance bayan 'room'.

examples.original: Is there a room for tonight?
examples.translation: Is there a room for tonight?
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'Is there...?' don tambayar idan wani abu ya kasance.

examples.original: Are there any free rooms on Friday?
examples.phonetic: /ɑːr ðeər ˈɛni friː ruːmz ɒn ˈfraɪdeɪ/
examples.translation: Are there any rooms free on Friday?
examples.note: Don plurals, yi amfani da 'Are there any...?'. Da fatan za a yi amfani da 'on' tare da kwanaki.

examples.original: I'm sorry, we're fully booked.
examples.translation: Babu kaya, muna ciki da kaya.
examples.note: Fasaha mai yau ce don cewa ba a sami kaya. 'Fully booked' ya fi 'muna ciki da kaya'.

examples.original: I'd like to book a double room for three nights.
examples.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk tə bʊk ə ˈdʌbəl ruːm fɔː θriː naɪts/
examples.translation: Ina son rashin da kaya mai biyu da kaya a lokacin uku da dare.
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'I'd like' (rashin 'would like') don yin fasaha mai zurfi.

examples.original: Can I reserve a room with a balcony?
examples.phonetic: /kæn aɪ rɪˈzɜːv ə ruːm wɪð ə ˈbælkəni/
examples.translation: Can I book a room with a balcony?
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'Can I...?' don nuna tambaya. 'With' ya fi 'da' don bayyana fasaha.

examples.original: My name is Ana García. I have a reservation.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ neɪm ɪz ˈɑːnə ɡɑːrˈsiːə aɪ hæv ə ˌrezəˈveɪʃən/
examples.translation: My name is Ana García. I have a reservation.
examples.note: Da zuwa hoton, ka fada sunanka da cewa ka da rashin da kaya. 'Reservation' ya fi 'rashin da kaya'.

examples.original: I need to cancel my reservation.
examples.translation: I need to cancel my reservation.
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'need to' + verb don nuna bukata. 'Cancel' ya fi 'wuce'.

levels.label: Questions about price and amenities
levels.translation: Tambayar game da farashin da fasaha

examples.original: How much is it per night?
examples.translation: Me yaushe ne a kwanaki?
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'How much' don tambayar farashi. 'Per night' ya fi 'a kwanaki'.

examples.original: Does the price include breakfast?
examples.translation: Does the price include breakfast?
examples.note: A fasaha na uku mai yau, yi amfani da 'Does' don tambaya. 'Include' ya fi 'cike'.

examples.original: Is Wi-Fi free?
examples.translation: Is the Wi-Fi free?
examples.note: A Turanci, 'is' ya kasance a gaba da subject a tambaya. 'Free' na iya nufin 'babu kudi' ko 'ya yi wuce'.

examples.original: What time is check-out?
examples.translation: What time is check-out?
examples.note: 'Check-out' ya fi 'sauke kaya', 'check-in' ya fi 'shiga kaya'. Su ne a matsayin suna.

title: At the Bank or Exchange Office / A kan banki ko fashe haraji
bridge: A cikin Turanci, don neman wani abu da alheri, an yi amfani da 'I would like...' ko 'Can I...?', while a cikin Turanci muke yi amfani da 'Quisiera...' ko '¿Me da...?'. Muna lura cewa a Turanci, 'can' da 'would' masu yin wasa suna da dama da wasanni ne, ba tare da 'to' ba, da kuma yadda kalmomin yawan abu kamar 'some' ko 'any' suka canza ne da yadda kalma ta kasance da positive, negative ko tambaya. Kuma, a Turanci, adadin da kudi sunyi da dama: misali, '100 dollars' a Turanci an yi 'one hundred dollars', da kuma decimal za a yi amfani da tsinkiya, ba koma ba.
rule: Don yin fashe ko fashe a banki ko gida mai fashe, yana bukatun ka yi amfani da kalmomin alheri da 'I would like' (na yarda) da dama da kuma 'to' + wasanni ne a cikin infinitive. Misali: 'I would like to exchange dollars' (Na yarda in fashe dolarsu). Da kuma 'Can I...?' (Zan iya...?) don neman izini, kamar 'Can I open an account?' (Zan iya buɗe asusu?). Don nuna yadda fashe, an yi 'What is the exchange rate?' (Me ne yadda fashe?). Muna lura cewa a Turanci, abubuwan da za a iya suka canza yadda 'some' (positive) da 'any' (negative/tambaya). Kuma muna da muhimmanci da tsarin kalmomi: a tambayoyi, wasanni masu yin wasa ko masu yin wasa suna da dama da sabon sunan. Don nuna yawan abu, ka yi amfani da adadin da kudi bayan, misali 'fifty dollars' (fifiti da dolarsu).

concept_examples.text: I would like to exchange some dollars.
concept_examples.translation: Na yarda in fashe wasu dolarsu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tuː ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ sʌm ˈdɑːlərz/

concept_examples.text: Can I open a bank account?
concept_examples.translation: Zan iya buɗe asusu na banki?

concept_examples.text: I need to withdraw some money.
concept_examples.translation: Ina bukata in yi wuce wasu kudi.

common_error.correct_alt: I would like to change money.
common_error.explanation: A cikin Turanci muke yi 'quiero cambiar dinero' ba tare da preposition ba, amma a Turanci, wasanni kamar 'want' da 'would like' suna bukatun da particle 'to' kafin wasanni ne a cikin infinitive da yake da dama. Saboda haka, ya kamata ka yi 'I want to change...' ko 'I would like to change...'. Wani kuskure ne a cikin wasanni ne a cikin 'want', wanda ya sa yaduwa. Ka tuna da yin amfani da 'to' tsakanin wasanni da infinitive.

levels.label: Basic Phrases for Exchanging Money
levels.translation: Kalmo na farko don fashe kudi

examples.original: I would like to exchange euros for pounds.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tuː ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ ˈjʊərəʊz fɔː paʊndz/
examples.translation: Na yarda in fashe yuro da fasa.
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'for' don nuna kudi da ke son samu.

examples.original: What is the rate for dollars?
examples.translation: Me ne yadda fashe na dolarsu?
examples.note: Tambaya game da yadda fashe da yi amfani da 'rate'.

examples.original: Can I have some small bills?
examples.translation: Zan iya samun takardun da ake kira 'small bills'?
examples.note: 'Small bills' yana nufin takardun da ake kira 'small denominations'.

examples.original: Is there a commission?
examples.translation: Ana da wata fees?
examples.note: A Turanci, tambaya da yi amfani da 'Is there...?' don guda.

examples.original: I want to deposit this check into my account.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɒnt tuː dɪˈpɒzɪt ðɪs tʃek ˈɪntuː maɪ əˈkaʊnt/
examples.translation: Ina son a kan deposit wannan cheque a cikin asusuna.
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'into my account' don nuna inda kudi zai zama.

examples.original: Can you withdraw money from my account?
examples.phonetic: /kæn juː wɪðˈdrɔː ˈmʌni frɒm maɪ əˈkaʊnt/
examples.translation: Zan iya wuce kudi daga asusuna?
examples.note: 'Withdraw from' ne preposition daidai.

examples.original: How much is the service fee?
examples.translation: Me ne fees na sabis?
examples.note: Tambaya game da kudin da yi amfani da 'How much'.

examples.original: My account number is 12345.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ əˈkaʊnt ˈnʌmbər ɪz wʌn tuː θriː fɔː faɪv/
examples.translation: Nambar asusuna na ni ita ce 12345.
examples.note: A Turanci, adadin za a yi da yadda kalmomi ko a cikin gaba.

examples.original: I need to transfer money online.
examples.translation: Ina bukata in yi fashe kudi ta internet.
examples.note: Yi amfani da 'online' don nuna fashewar da ake yi ta intanet.

examples.original: This is a currency exchange form.
examples.translation: Wannan ne takarda na fashe haraji.
examples.note: 'Currency' yana nufin kudi na waje.

translations.ha: A kan banki ko fashe haraji
